name: Verde Kitchen & Bar
notes: All 3 photos are the same Hilton Garden Inn breakfast menu card; photos 1 and 2 are identical prints, photo 3 is an older/alternate print with slightly different pricing on 3 items (Continental Buffet $14 vs Hot Breakfast Buffet $24, Parfait $12 vs $10, Perfect Pancakes $9 vs $10) — used the prices matching two of three photos.

dishes.name: Hot Breakfast Buffet
